observed_problem: Prediction studies use heterogeneous signals, exposure protocols and sickness labels; cross-dataset/device generalization may be weak
evidence_needed: verify closest 2023-2026 predictors; map public datasets and cross-device tests
next_gate: establish common outcome and public data

observed_problem: Mitigation methods trade sickness against field of view, presence, task performance or visual quality
evidence_needed: map dynamic FOV, rest-frame, locomotion and adaptive mitigation baselines
next_gate: identify reproducible non-human proxy plus validated human outcomes

observed_problem: Algorithms optimize resets, path deviation, collisions or perceptual detectability under differing spaces and user models
evidence_needed: verify canonical and recent controllers plus standard simulators

observed_problem: Methods trade perceptual quality, GPU cost, latency and gaze prediction under differing hardware
evidence_needed: map rendering families and open implementations/datasets
possible_benchmark: common gaze traces/scenes with quality-performance metrics

observed_problem: VR tracking methods differ by sensor modality and target, making naive accuracy ranking invalid
evidence_needed: partition eye, hand, body and inside-out tracking before comparison
next_gate: identify one modality with open data and unresolved generalization

observed_problem: Prediction reduces motion-to-photon/network effects but horizon and motion distributions differ
evidence_needed: map predictors by horizon/input modality and deployment setting
possible_benchmark: common trajectory traces and horizon sweep
next_gate: find public traces and comparable horizons

observed_problem: Quality-latency-bandwidth trade-offs are optimized with different viewport prediction and network assumptions
evidence_needed: map viewport prediction, tile allocation and edge scheduling methods
major_risk: datasets and codecs may be non-comparable
next_gate: identify open traces and standard QoE metrics

observed_problem: Threat models and authentication methods often use different attacker knowledge, biometrics and devices
evidence_needed: separate attack, defense and authentication benchmarks
possible_benchmark: public motion/gaze/behavior datasets where ethical and available

observed_problem: Adaptive systems optimize different user-state proxies and objectives; reproducibility may be limited
evidence_needed: map state variables, actions, objectives and adaptation policies
major_risk: reward definitions may encode incomparable goals
